nodes.label: Case Notes - Add Note UI (Nexo Commercial Distributors Corp.)
nodes.description: UI screenshot of the 'Case notes' feature in Captio. Shows a form to add a new note to Case #6 for 'Nexo Commercial Distributors Corp.' (Business/Contract). The form has fields: Title (filled with 'Case review'), Parent notes (with helper text for hierarchical note organization, showing 'No notes in this case yet. This will be an independent note.'), and a Note textarea with sample content. A 'Save note' button is present. Navigation shows breadcrumb '← Cases' and '← Options'. User avatar 'T' (tole) visible top-right.

nodes.label: Add Case Note Form

nodes.label: Parent Note Hierarchy Feature
nodes.description: Feature allowing notes to be nested under parent notes. If no parent exists, note is independent. Helper text: 'Select the notes this note belongs to. You can leave it independent.'
